// revenueReport answers the money taken per day: ?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (both included).
func (s *Server) revenueReport(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	days, err := reports.Revenue(s.store, p.OrgID, q.Get("from"), q.Get("to"))
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, reports.ErrInvalidDate):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_date", err.Error())
		return
	case errors.Is(err, reports.ErrInvalidRange):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_range", err.Error())
		return
	case err != nil:
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"days": days})
}

// ?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (both included)[&group=day|week|month].
func (s *Server) revenueReport(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	rep, err := reports.RevenueReport(s.store, p.OrgID, q.Get("from"), q.Get("to"), q.Get("group"))
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, reports.ErrInvalidDate):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_date", err.Error())
		return
	case errors.Is(err, reports.ErrInvalidRange):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_range", err.Error())
		return
	case errors.Is(err, reports.ErrInvalidGroup):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_group", err.Error())
		return
	case err != nil:
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, rep)
}
